reason: Release v0.33.0: raises the app version to 0.33.0 in package.json and package-lock.json and moves the Unreleased CHANGELOG lines into the v0.33.0 section, with a summary of the release. The README leads with v0.33.0, keeps v0.32.0, v0.31.0 and v0.30.1, and folds v0.30.0 into the CHANGELOG sentence; its opening now counts eight Templates, with the coffee roasting batch that joined them. The README's three scenes and the 3-zone doc's Premium Pickup close-up are retaken on this release's build, with the same scenes and descriptions, so they show the zone names as tabs, the selected item's name and path, and the Timeline's current line colours.
